thread:
Priya: Heads-up — planning a staged rollout for feature/batching-v2 + an experiment to compare batching strategies. Need quick alignment on audiences, guardrails, and stopping rules. Target start tomorrow 10:00 UTC.

Mateo: Proposed split: 1) internal-only 1% (all regions) 2) beta customers 5% (us + eu) 3) public ramp 10% -> 25% over 48h if stable. Experiment variants: control (batching-v1), batching-v2 (kernel optimizations + kv cache tweak).

Ben: SGTM re audiences. Two infra guardrails: auto-rollback if overall p99 latency increases by >50ms for any region, OR if token error rate (5xx or timeouts) increases by >0.4% absolute. Also add capacity throttle to avoid OOM spikes.

Carla: From QA: add a quality monitor that runs our prompt-suite (smoke eval) every 15m on the canary cohorts. Stop if average QA accuracy drops >2% or if hallucination rate jumps >1.5x. We'll stream sample outputs to a private S3 prefix for manual checks.

Alice: I'll handle flag config + rollout job. Draft flag JSON for the platform (will create canary groups named: internal, beta, public):

```
{
  "flag": "feature/batching-v2",
  "variants": ["v1_control", "v2_batching_opt"],
  "audiences": {
    "internal": {"percent": 1, "members": "team-internal"},
    "beta": {"percent": 5, "tags": ["beta-cust"], "regions": ["us-east-1","eu-west-1"]},
    "public": {"percent": 10}
  },
  "ramp": [{"after_hours": 24, "to_percent": 25}],
  "safety": {
    "p99_latency_ms_delta": 50,
    "error_rate_delta_pct": 0.4,
    "quality_delta_pct": 2.0
  }
}
```

Mateo: Nice. For the experiment framework, we'll run A/B with metric hooks: p50/p95/p99 latency, tokens-per-request cost, error rate, and QA_accuracy. Use sequential testing with daily checks; initial stop criteria is any guardrail breach but also stop if we have 99% CI showing v2 worse on QA_accuracy by >1.5%.

Ben: Also make sure routing fallback exists: if v2 instances are out-of-capacity, route to v1 or to a lower-cost variant. Add an alert on fallback rate >0.5% to paging channel eng-oncall.

Carla: Smoke checklist before ramp: 1) run eval-suite on internal cohort 2) run 50k synthetic short/long requests to check kv cache behavior 3) verify logs & traces include batch_id and kernel tag

Priya: Good catches. Who will own automatic rollback action? I want one-click manual rollback and an automated Rollback job with a 3x confirmation window before global ramp to 25%.

Alice: I can hook the rollout job to the feature-ops service. It will: create canary groups, start experiment, attach metric hooks, and run rollback playbook if thresholds exceeded. Manual rollback will be a UI button plus Slack confirm flow.

DevOpsBot: CI checks for batching-v2 image: unit tests OK, integration smoke OK, infra diff OK. No pending infra approvals.

QA-Bot: Pre-roll smoke run (internal 1%) results: QA_accuracy delta: 0.1% worse (within tolerance), p99 delta: +12ms, error rate delta: +0.02%. All checks PASS for initial canary.

Mateo: Post these, let's schedule start 10:00 UTC. I'll post the rollout runbook in the deployment doc. If anyone wants to opt a customer out of the beta cohort, ping me and I'll add their tag exclude.

Priya: Great — final asks: Ben, ensure alert runbook points to oncall + escalation matrix. Carla, please set up the eval dashboard and share a link here. Alice, link the rollout job ID once created. We'll meet async for 10m sync right before start. :rocket:

Ben: Will do.

Carla: Dashboard link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/exp/batching-v2 (read-only for the team). I'll add synthetic tests and the prompt-suite watch.

Alice: Rollout job created: job/rv-2026-0317-01. Linking in docs now.

Priya: Thanks team — keeping this thread as the single source for questions during the window. Ping here for any urgent issues. :white_check_mark:
